mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 255.0 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, it signals an imminent monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%), the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1100.0, it signals a weakening housing market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in the real economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
